answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 436 identities costs 436 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The whisper of the design is public, the thread of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ember of honest work is what finally pays.
